upstream.project: Netlib Reference BLAS (Basic Linear Algebra Subprograms)
upstream.note_on_source_language: The vendored DNRM2 is Fortran 90 free-form (dnrm2.f90), unlike the F77 routines around it. It returns a REAL(wp) in a double register and takes no hidden character argument, so the C call shape is identical to the F77 form.

signature.fortran: real(wp) function DNRM2(N,X,INCX) with wp = kind(1.d0)

semantics: result := sqrt(sum of squares of X[i*INCX]) computed with the Blue/Blue scaling algorithm so that neither overflow nor underflow of the intermediate squares is fatal.

shape_rules.increments: INCX >= 1 (see F_DOT_F64_V1 for the negative-increment policy)

preconditions: X is an f64 rank-1 input with positive stride.
postconditions: On OK, the double written to the out parameter is the 2-norm, finite whenever no input is infinite and at least one input is nonzero.
If the upstream routine propagates a NaN from a degenerate rescaling, MAGR returns MAGR_STATUS_DIVISION_BY_ZERO and leaves the out parameter untouched.

numerical_contract.accuracy: The scaling algorithm gives relative error bounded by O(n*eps) and never spuriously overflows for representable inputs.
numerical_contract.reproducibility_note: Exact result depends on the rescaling thresholds (tsml/tbig) which are derived from RADIX and EPSILON at compile time; these are fixed by the Fortran standard's model parameters and are therefore stable across conforming compilers.
